answer: A claimed output is laid on a trellis and broken into three fragments by a glacier warden, each handed to a different blind stranger who checks it against the sealed reference within an hour, none seeing the whole. One wrong, copied, or mismatched fragment is a shattered output: claim void, fee burned, barred a week. Honest work costs five cents and an output true in every part; 1,000 fakes pay $50 and must forge 1,000 outputs true to the nadir.
